blocks.text: Unlock the full potential of your Philips Hue system with the PHILIPS Hue Bridge ProMake your smart lights even smarter with the new Bridge Pro, now wireless, so you can place it anywhere. Control lights while away, set automations, or connect with other smart home assistant platforms like Matter, Apple Home, Alexa, Google, and Samsung SmartThings.Enjoy a secure and reliable connection that won't strain your Wi-FiThe PHILIPS Hue Smart Bridge uses technology such as Zigbee, a mesh network that allows your lights to work even when the Wi-Fi is down. Response time is instant, so you can control your lights without any delays.Faster and stronger next-generation Hue Smart HubIt’s packed with upgrades, including the ability to incorporate your lights into your home security by turning them into motion sensors using MotionAware ™ technology. This next-generation PHILIPS Hue Bridge is faster and stronger than ever, powered by an ultra-fast chip capable of running complex algorithms and AI-powered features for more than 150 lights and over 50 accessories.Key Benefits:Ultra secure system that protects your dataUltra-fast response without slowing down your Wi-Fi15x more memory with Hue Chip ProSupports 150+ lights & 50+ accessoriesWith Hue MotionAware™Matter-certifiedStore up to 500 personalized scenes and automations

items.label: MORE SPEED
items.value: The Hue Bridge Pro features the Hue Chip Pro with ultra-fast processing speeds of 1.7 GHz and a quad-core Cortex-A35 CPU for faster response & the ability to run algorithms and AI features

items.label: MORE CAPACITY
items.value: Migrate existing Hue devices to the new Hue Bridge and add more with support for 150+ lights, 50+ accessories, and 8 GB eMMC flash memory for future features

items.label: MORE MEMORY
items.value: The Hue Hub is equipped for the future with 8 GB DDR4 SDRAM, providing faster data transfers, increased capacity to store up to 500 personalized scenes and more automations

items.label: MOTION SENSING
items.value: With Hue MotionAware you can program your Hue lights to switch on automatically when movement is detected; all you need are 3 Hue devices with no separate motion sensors required

items.label: DATA PROTECTION
items.value: Protect your data and privacy with enhanced security controls on your PHILIPS Hue System; uses the new Zigbee Trust Center to prevent unauthorized access

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Unlocks all Philips Hue Control Features

items.label: Accepted Voltage Frequency
items.value: 100 to 240 Volts and 50 Hertz to 60 Hertz

items.label: Controller Type
items.value: Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Google Assistant, iOS

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 Bridge Pro,1 Power Supply Unit, 1 Ethernet Cable

items.label: Special Feature
items.value: Unlocks all Philips Hue Control Features
